about: Pending qualifications and errata, shown with the record or note they qualify in RESULTS.md, on the site and on THEORY.md's cards. Add an entry when a later result qualifies a published one; remove it when the record is reissued or superseded, and record the change in HISTORY.md.

items.text: Qualification pending: false at 2-edge cuts, where parts meet as two-place parity, and exact only up to signs at 3-edge cuts (see NATIVE-PATHS-20261101-001).
Qualification pending: the face law fails at junctions and holds after reduction (see FACE-CLAIM-20261103-001).
Qualification pending: the law holds after reduction (see the FACE-CLAIM-20261103-001 closure).

Interpretation pending: whether counted length is a native magnitude has not been decided; read it as a count, not a distance. Qualification pending: the glue's part is its tree-trinity logarithm only when the glue is planar; a non-planar glue piece adds the logarithm of its own amplitude, which depends on how it is glued (see THREEFOLD-AMPLITUDE-20261030-001B).
Erratum pending: abstract item 5, Section 6 and Theorem 12 say the knot's spaces compose only through hubs, which is false at 2-edge cuts (see NATIVE-PATHS-20261101-001).
Qualification pending: the second sentence, on census 6, holds only in the order in which each gluing line's points are written; that atoms act as one holds natively (see GENUS-READ-20261107-001).

Qualification pending: the rule reads these spaces only with census 6 glued in the order in which each line's points are written; with census 6 counted over its three gluings, its split step cuts every atom of six or seven lines (see GENUS-READ-20261107-001).

Qualification pending: the rule is known in substance. Kenyon and Stephenson (Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 147, 2019) give the pinwheel a coordinate-free subdivision rule with four-cornered tiles, the fourth corner at the long leg's midpoint. New here are the rule's form on a parity law's knots and distinctions, its eleven-label alphabet and its exact check (see the PINWHEEL-NATIVE-20261107-001 decision note).

Qualification pending: "on every three-fold space" holds when the glue is planar. A non-planar glue piece contributes its own amplitude, which is not Tutte's number and depends on how the piece is glued: 6 for three cubes glued along a square, 13 or 14 for prisms of sizes 2, 3 and 3 (see THREEFOLD-AMPLITUDE-20261030-001B, and Corollary 5 of THREEFOLD-AMPLITUDE-20261030-001C).

Qualification pending: "for which only tree-like size was known" is wrong. Dantchev (On the complexity of the Sperner lemma, CiE 2006, LNCS 3988, 115-124) reduces the pigeonhole principle to Sperner's lemma and shows that it has no short constant-depth Frege proofs, which already gives superpolynomial general-resolution lower bounds for Sperner formulas. New, as far as found, are the tight width Theta(m) and, in COUNT-NOTE-20261107-001, the tight size 2^Theta(m).
